testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal controls, table actions, and stat widgets MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive, full-featured React single-page application for AS SHIDIQ SANTRI MANAGEMENT with mock backend persistence using SWR/Axios or React state so all CRUD, filtering, batch operations, search, and PDF generation work seamlessly.
Include emergent-based Google login on the Auth page with smooth transition to the Admin Dashboard.
Maintain the rich Emerald Green (#047857) + Gold/Amber (#D97706) aesthetic with Islamic geometric touches throughout.
Use Lucide-react icons for clear, crisp administrative navigation.
Provide modal popups for adding/editing santri, recording payments, creating batch bills, and viewing printable receipts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes as required.
